errors.BAD_REQUEST: Something in your request is not valid. Check the details and try again.

errors.NOT_FOUND: We could not find what you asked for.
errors.CONFLICT: This conflicts with the current state. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.UNPROCESSABLE: We could not process those details. Check them and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a while and try again.
errors.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: RejectRadar is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
errors.HTTP_ERROR: Something went wrong with that request. Please try again.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
